purpose: Finest breadth of human chess from 1834 to 2022 across world championships, candidates, national events, women's chess, correspondence and annotated classics. Complements the rating-banded data/training/ set.
method: Games copied verbatim from the pinned sources; split_by_era files partitioned by per-game Date year; every file then move-legality-cleaned (per-game parse, games with dropped SAN tokens dropped and counted). No dedup — cross-file duplicates are counted and documented.
